stage: Stage 1 input/scenario inventory; NOT a captured/frozen baseline
inputHashEncoding: Canonical JSON: recursively sort object keys with localeCompare; preserve arrays and exact source text.

provenance.synthetic: Recorded every buildDiagram invocation while executing original flow.test.mjs callbacks and assertions. Input objects cloned before build; expanded sets copied in iteration order. All original assertions passed.
provenance.native: Copied compiler tests to a temporary package; instrumented only test call sites of Analyze and resolveProgram to record original Files and t.Name(), then forwarded to unchanged functions. Full copied go test ./... passed. Deduplicated identical inputs per test, preserving source bytes.
provenance.browser: Lifted each original workspace.write argument from flow.spec.mjs in source order against its original example snapshot; all 12 writes resolved. Preserved exact expression and source line in inputs/browser.json.
provenance.discovery: Native Analyze on all unique projects establishes current selectable scope/endpoint/function IDs; expansion paths and action labels come from original buildDiagram/nodeHint. Catalog is saved, not recomputed by loadRenderCases.
provenance.panelDimensions: Project inspection is the third 20% grid column (not the 60% chat column); header occupies 68px. Expanded inspection fills workspace below header. Synthetic fixtures explicitly fix their existing workspace to 1500x950px and inspection occupies its first 20% column. No output normalization. Gap-closure probes replayed all 49 added synthetic expanded states and 22 added/corrected browser states in fresh headless Chromium development contexts, checking exact inspection dimensions. Synthetic expanded inspection measured 1500x950; browser collapsed-resized inspection measured 180x582 (900x650 viewport) or 180x632 (900x700 viewport). No capture files were written and no full recorder or production corpus was run.

limitations: This inventory alone does not certify frozen SVG/HTML/screenshots, environment reproducibility, or Stage 1 completion. astExpectation=true identifies original project input eligible for Stage 3 AST coverage, not an existing AST golden.

Original synthetic graph-model fixtures lack function entry metadata and deliberately omit FlowEntry only. State-only synthetic fixtures retain full metadata when available. All synthetic cases explicitly declare no separate AST golden.
Non-rendering source/transport/checker/workspace suites remain inventoried with unchanged tests, not mislabeled as full-component captures.
Chat/provider/drag/concurrency assertions remain behavioral coverage in original browser tests; catalog captures flow states, not every chat message/sidebar animation.
Functions not reachable from a discovered scope are recorded as uninspectable and are not misrepresented as selectable UI views.

Scenario mappings distinguish flow-state capture from behavioral-only chat/provider/sidebar tests. A mapped generic project view is not a claim that all interactions from its original test are replayed.

Synthetic expanded cases opt into the existing production inspection-expanded wrapper class via panel.mode; they cover layout only, not an invented synthetic toggle. Dimensions are fixed host width/height; original normal states are retained.
